label: DiskStation DS923+ 4-bay NAS
description: 4-bay desktop NAS with two 1GbE RJ45 ports and one PCIe 3.0 x2 network upgrade slot. That slot is the only route to 10GbE, via Synology's E10G22-T1-Mini module.
notes: Onboard: 2x 1GbE RJ45 only - 10GbE is NOT onboard, it needs the E10G22-T1-Mini in the PCIe 3.0 x2 slot. No OOB management port. Link aggregation supported.
